h1: Saudi Arabia business visa from the UK
intro: The Saudi business visa is for meetings, negotiations, conferences and site visits in Saudi Arabia. It's mainly for UK residents who don't hold a British passport, or who need a visa rather than an ETA. We check your documents, complete your application and submit it for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for business meetings, conferences or site visits
You have an invitation from a company in Saudi Arabia
You won't take up paid work in Saudi Arabia

sections.heading: Single or multiple entry
sections.text: You can choose a single-entry visa, or a multiple-entry visa valid for 6 months, 1 year or 2 years if you travel to Saudi Arabia regularly. All options are usually processed in about 72 hours.

sections.heading: British citizens: you may only need an ETA
sections.text: Since July 2026, British passport holders can visit Saudi Arabia for business on the [Saudi ETA](/saudi-arabia-eta-uk/), which is quicker and cheaper. We'll tell you which option suits your trip.

sections.heading: Saudi business visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help UK companies and business travellers with Saudi business visas. We check your invitation and documents before anything is submitted.

faqs.q: How long does a Saudi business visa take?
faqs.a: Usually about 72 hours once your application is submitted.

faqs.q: Do I need an invitation letter?
faqs.a: Yes. You need an invitation from the company you're visiting in Saudi Arabia.

faqs.q: Can I work on a Saudi business visa?
faqs.a: No. For employment you need a [Saudi work visa](/saudi-work-visa-uk/).
